23.text: When the dead body is out of the tent, it is carried to the real entrance,

24.text: and put on a sledge which has been placed at the left side. With a new

25.text: thong it is carefully tied to the sledge. The head of the sledge is pointed

26.text: toward the entrance of the house; and the rear of the sledge, in the direction

27.text: of the way to be taken.

28.text: If possible, an entirely new sledge is used; but, that failing, the best

29.text: one obtainable is selected for the purpose. All broken and mended parts

30.text: are, as far as possible, replaced by new ones, which are considered more

31.text: suitable for the long journey of the dead person. Two long round poles are

32.text: put crosswise under the runners, so that the sledge, with the body tied on

33.text: it, may easily be drawn forward and backward, the poles acting as rollers.
